layout.body:
To : All students
From: Laura Lee
Date: May 31
Subject: Event Notice
Dear students,
The school is organizing a Career Exploration Day on November 15th from 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM in the main auditorium. This event will feature professionals from various fields including medicine, engineering, arts, and business who will share their career experiences.
All students in grades 10-12 are encouraged to attend. You'll have opportunities to ask questions and participate in interactive sessions. Please register your attendance by November 10th so we can prepare enough materials. A detailed schedule will be sent to all registered students one week before the event.
This is a valuable chance to learn about different career paths and network with professionals. We hope to see many of you there!
Best regards,
Laura Lee

options.B: To promote a career exploration event
